entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viktor Weber Edler von Webenau was an Austrian military officer who served as General in the Austro-Hungarian Army during World War I, military governor of Montenegro between 1916 and 1917 and head of the Austro-Hungarian armistice commission for the Armistice of Villa Giusti.
